svg.title: DCE/RPC: a 16-byte common header, then the request
svg.desc: The Request of frame 40263 of The-Ultimate-PCAP.pcapng, 32 bits per row: the 16-byte common header, version 5.0, PDU type 0, flags 0x03, the data representation label 10 00 00 00 for little-endian, ASCII and IEEE, a fragment length of 168 and an authentication length of 0, both little-endian, and call identifier 2; then the three fields of a Request, an allocation hint of 144, presentation context 1 and operation number 3, and 144 bytes of stub data; DceRpcPdu keeps the header fields, the byte order, the body as bytes, and gives the three request fields on demand.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
